message.content:
An editorial illustration shows a stylized man sitting on the back of a large crocodile. The man has a stout build, wearing a light brown short-sleeved button-up shirt and dark pants. He holds thin red reins that are looped around the crocodile’s snout. A larger figure in a dark suit sits behind him, though only its lower torso, legs, and a gloved hand pointing forward are visible. The crocodile is grey and scaly, shown in a three-quarter view with its mouth closed, revealing white triangular teeth.

The background is predominantly white with a thick red vertical border on the left. Large black text reads “SIAPA DI BALIK FIRLI”. Smaller text below describes an investigation by “Tim Indonesialeaks” regarding “tes wawasan kebangsaan” and “Ketua KPK Firli Bahuri.” Top headlines mention “NASIB GARUDA DI UJUNG TANDUK” and “JOR JORAN BELANJA ALUTSISTA PRABOWO.” The magazine title "TEMPO" is partially visible in large red letters. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom left corner, alongside the date “7-13 JUNI 2021” and the price “RP 45.000.”
